w: Swamishri performed the ground-breaking ceremony of 'Shri C.J. Patel Vidyadham', an educational complex, that will comprise of a Commerce College, Computer Academy and Dental College.
ph: Blessing an assembly after the ground - breaking ceremony

w: Swamishri participated in a yagna for the opening of the new assembly hall in the mandir precincts. A total of 810 devotees participated in the yagna. Finally, in his blessings Swamishri said, "Today, for the inauguration of the new assembly hall we are participating in a yagna. We listen to spiritual discourses, sing kirtan and bhajan and perform yagnas to please God... Shriji Maharaj has through an analogy explained that we should engage and sacrifice our senses in God, that is, with our eyes we should do His darshan and through our ears listen to His glory. By doing this day and night we attain a state where God is realized in our hearts and we see nothing but Him. When this happens then the yagna is said to have been completed..."

Bal Din: In the evening satsang assembly members of the kishore mandal enacted a drama called ‘Paksh”. Thereafter balaks and kishores performed a traditional dance on the bhajan “Yagnapurushne dwãr…”. Thereafter, Swamishri was honoured with garlands. Finally, in his blessings, Swamishri explained, “This village is fortunate and blessed. Shastriji Maharaj was born here and a mandir has been made here. Those who come here on a pilgrimage receive the fruits of doing all pilgrimages. The reason being that Maharaj, Swami and Lakshmi-Narayan are present here in the murtis.”

ds.t: Better to chant than to sleep
w: This morning, right after the mangala arti, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to go for his bath. Swamishri was much earlier than usual, so the sadhus requested, "Rest a little, then we will go when it is time." But Swamishri at once said, "Rather than sleep, let us chant God's name." Saying this, Swamishri sat on a chair and began turning his mala. Swamishri turned the mala for about twenty five minutes.
Today during the meetings, a devotee named Dr Ankur Paldiya came. He asked Mahant Swami Maharaj, "The prayer I make to you every day in my puja reaches you, doesn't it?"
"Yes," Swamishri said. What could be unknown to Aksharbrahma, who knows all hearts?! In this single word of his lies a unique reassurance for all satsangis.
As Mahant Swami Maharaj was leaving today, Divyakirtandas Swami, choking with emotion, said, "Bapa! After you go, I won't like it here..."

Swamishri said lovingly, "There is such a beautiful Ghanshyam Maharaj, full of glory. Fix your mind on him. He will fulfil your wishes..." And Divyakirtandas Swami's eyes became even more full of emotion...

He said, "In 2008 I was posted here. At first I did not like it, and then Swamibapa said exactly these words: 'Do not have any other wish. Ghanshyam Maharaj there is full of glory. Fix your mind on him. He will fulfil all your wishes...' I became convinced that the Satpurush is one and the same."
In the car from Surendranagar to Mehsana

At the sadhus' request, Mahant Swami Maharaj set off for Mehsana seated in an Alphard Toyota car. Within a few minutes Swamishri said, "The devotees can't see anything..." The reason was that a film had been applied to the car's windows, so that from inside one could see outside clearly, but from outside nothing inside could be seen.
The attendant sadhus apologised, "For lack of time this escaped our attention. We will take care next time..."
Uneasiness could be seen on Swamishri's face. So the attendant sadhus gently asked, "You are comfortable, aren't you, Swami!?"

The devotees of the villages along the way were staring hard at the windows, yet they could not have darshan, and this kept going round in Swamishri's mind, so he said with some emphasis, "We are comfortable, but these people (the devotees) are not (that is, they cannot have darshan)."
The attendant sadhus said, "The other car is right behind. If you say so, we can change..."
Swamishri immediately said "Yes". Within half an hour Swamishri moved from a car with many more facilities to a car with fewer facilities... only for the wellbeing of the devotees.
Swamishri has offered his body completely for the devotees, because Swamishri does not think of himself in the least and thinks of the devotees boundlessly.
Today Mahant Swami Maharaj sat down to take his evening meal. No sadhus or devotees had come for darshan. Referring to this, Swamishri asked the attendant, "Eating alone for five days?"

"No, no, Swami!" Explaining the facts, the attendant sadhu said, "For one thing it is late, and secondly, 4,000 devotees were expected and about 5,500 devotees have flocked for the welcome... so the sadhus of every department have got busy in serving and looking after them."
